pos.personaBrief: Telê's São Paulo was built on possession, short triangulations and controlling the rhythm (Lance possession facts), refusing defensive football.

pro.personaBrief: Volantes started the build-up with short combinations and the side played on the ground; patient, technical progression with a mobile front without a reference striker.

est.personaBrief: Constant position swaps (Cafu/Müller, Raí entering the box, Palhinha dropping) and a centroavante-less mobile front show a relational side, with Telê's tactical discipline as counterweight.

lar.personaBrief: Width came from attacking full-backs (Cafu, Vítor, Ronaldo Luís) rather than touchline wingers, while the creators Raí, Palhinha and Müller moved inside and across.

blo.personaBrief: An offensive side that marcava forte and defended with advanced lines, but with no verified pressing evidence; Telê rejected excessive defensive play.

mar.personaBrief: No source on marking; a Brazilian four-man line with Cerezo/Pintado screening suggests zonal habits and no dedicated man-marking.

pla.personaBrief: Telê imposed a clear identity (possession, technique, offensive courage) and scouted opponents only as detail; he did tweak, such as three volantes without Raí, but kept the model.

res.personaBrief: The Cruyff pact to play beautifully and loyally regardless of result and rejection of time-wasting show a strong spectacle orientation, though he won everything.

sis.personaBrief: Perfectionist drill, repetition and collective discipline, with stars like Raí holding defined roles; the system was favoured over unlimited freedom.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, ball-playing players (Raí, Palhinha, Cerezo) and technique-first identity, with intense physical preparation as a basic requirement.

bas.personaBrief: A mature, experienced title-winning team (Zetti, Cerezo, Raí) with occasional youth like André at 18; Telê rotated by performance, with winning the priority.

lid.personaBrief: Telê was a demanding, perfectionist boss who picked on players, swapped vests mid-training and applied rules to everyone.
